rows.en: Whoa, C-Cap…!
Wh-what a thing to do…
It can't be…!? Ultraman… like this…
Damn, it got us!!
Torubeeni iushi haukoomu Seamons, sorutoora shiirikooso rirabera Seagorath…
So this… is the other song?

[HERO4] reported that Mr. Tachibana knows another song, so…

[HERO4] was saying we should call off the attack…

[HERO4] reported that Mr. Tachibana knows another song, so…

[HERO4] was saying we should call off the attack…

Mm… But we can't just call off the attack that easily!

After all, the kaiju is rampaging right near Science Patrol HQ!

Run that song through the language analyzer right away and find out what it means!

Well… I hope I can be of some use…

Thing is… it's been a long, long time since I saw Seamons…

I'd gone out on a tuna boat to help a friend with the fishing. That's when it was… we ran into the thing out at sea…
I see… Really, thank you so much for going to the trouble.
Emergency report! Seamons has vanished!

What!?

But we can't relax yet! It might show up again… Hurry with that analysis!
This is the Special Forces Unit… We've just arrived!
Likewise… the Security Unit has arrived! We will now support the Science Patrol.

If these records are right…

the kaiju's name is Tornado Kaiju Seamons… and the other is Tsunami Kaiju Seagorath.
Kaiju like that… I've never even heard of them.

According to the records…

the two are a devoted married kaiju couple. Seamons is a female that walks on four legs… and Seagorath is a male that walks on two, apparently.
Captain! The results from the language analyzer are in.
Mm, and?

Yes, sir…

"Torment not Seamons. Torment Seamons and her horn will glow…"

"Torment Seamons and her horn will glow"?

"When the horn glows, Seagorath too will rage, the sea and the heavens and the earth will rage, and this world will become a hell…"
The sea and the heavens and the earth will rage? A hell? Captain, what does it mean?
Mm…
Captain! Seamons has appeared!!

What did you say!?

Kishida! What about that weapon?
Yes, sir… If we had about another week…
The Science Patrol, MAT, the lot of you… what on earth are you doing!? Tokyo is not a kaiju zoo!
Yes, sir…
What concrete measures do you have for driving off these kaiju?
Sir… We are currently developing a new weapon.
A new weapon?
The <c2>Laser Gun SP-70</c>, sir!
Will that weapon have any effect?
We won't know that until we try it…
When will it be ready?
In a week…

Too slow!

Pool the full strength of the TDF science group and finish it in 2 days!

Give the citizens of Tokyo peace of mind as soon as possible… Understood?
Sir!
Among the citizens, there's even talk that MAT is unnecessary! Pull yourselves together…
It's the rage of the heavens and the earth…

Captain! It's Seagorath! It has to be Seagorath!

It's… angry!

All right… MAT, prepare to sortie! We're going in to support the Science Patrol!

Fighting kaiju is our specialty! Right, Go? Isn't that so?
Captain! The new weapon is finished.
Good… MAT, move out!!

I see, now I get it!

Why the song warns to beware when the usually gentle Seamons crosses the sea… She crossed the sea to lay her eggs!

The two are a married kaiju couple! Even with animals, the mother gets on edge when it's time to lay eggs, right? That's what this is!

I see… So in the song, the heavens and the earth have raged!

In that case… what on earth does the remaining one, the sea, mean?

Beats me…

Anyway… I'll use the new weapon and attack its horn!

Give me solid cover!

Did I get it…!?

No, no good… It must have burrowed deep underground to escape!

Did I get it…!?

No, no good… It must have dived deep under the sea to escape!
Gooo!! Are you all right? Go…
Yes, sir… The kaiju couple has gone back to the sea.
Hmm… Maybe it was cruel of us to break off her horn?
Yes… I hope she has a healthy baby, don't you?
Hey, hey, you've got to be kidding! Healthy baby or not… that's just one more kaiju!
Right… Exactly! Ha ha ha…

All riiight… Captain Muramatsu has gone rushing back to HQ, so…

let's head back too…
What? What's starting now?

The sea rages…

That's it! The hair-raising, terrible thing… it meant a tsunami!
What a disaster…
At this rate… nobody will be saved!
Cap! Let's get out of here, quick…!
Everyone! Get away, quickly!! It's dangerous!!

Hey, Go…

Where do you think you're going? Go, come back! Go!!
(The only way is to push it back with the Ultra Barrier! All right…)
Reverse Chest!!
Ultraman vanished from before the people's eyes…
But even so… when crisis comes to this Earth once again, perhaps our Ultraman will come flying back from somewhere out there.
Farewell, Ultraman! Goodbye…
Nurekuuha hiumo kenakena Seamons, yoodosa haukoomu meuraa Seamons…
Torubeeni iushi haukoomu Seamons, sorutoora shiirikooso rirabera Seagorath…
Ide became a Doctor / Ide did not become a Doctor
Defeat Gigant and all the giant kaiju!
Defeat Gigant, Kelbaan, Seamons and all the giant kaiju!
Defeat Gigant, Kelbaan and all the giant kaiju!
Defeat Gigant, Kelbaan, Seagorath and all the giant kaiju!
Defeat Space Dinosaur Zetton!
Any Science Patrol member is defeated
Captain Kato or Go is defeated, or any Science Patrol member is defeated
Hayata is defeated

uncertain: U06502/U06567/U06568: song lyrics are nonsense words; romanized as written.
U06518/U06519: decoded song meaning put in "double quotes"; Seamons treated as female (U06515 says she is the female).
U06524: source row has no closing bracket; Kishida cut off by the scene change.
U06545: 奴の角 rendered "its horn" (Kato speaking of the kaiju as a target).
U06563: [VAR6] shouting 逆転チェスト in an Ultraman scene; glossary gives "Reverse Chest", used as is.
U06569: looks like a debug/branch-flag label (two options on two lines); kept both, joined with " / ". Meaning of イデが博士になった unclear (whether Ide stayed with Dr. Iwamoto?).
U06570-U06573: 兵打獣を配て / 大怪獣を全て garbled; read as 大怪獣を全て倒せ, "all the giant kaiju".
U06576: [ja] rendered "Captain Kato or Go is defeated" (either one, usual SRPG sense); literal "and".
